facts.fact: An International Growth Centre policy brief says most local councils still run on manual systems and lists lack of appropriate ICT infrastructure, such as internet connectivity and storage space, among the challenges to councils taking up technology; it gives no count of councils.

systems.platform: GIS; software and hardware donated by partners
systems.tiers: Lusaka City Council; not integrated into daily business or extended to the Valuation Department

systems.system: Digital base map of Lusaka (2017 imagery)
systems.owner: Ordnance Survey with the Commonwealth Association of Architects and the International Growth Centre, at the request of the Ministry of Local Government

note: The connectivity statement is a general challenge named in a list, not a measured absence at named councils; the value is the nearest in the closed list and the parent should weigh it as such. The event is undated, so the brief's own date is used.
